description: Check whether a paper is retracted, why, and what the current research says now — keyless, over Crossref and OpenAlex.

tools.name: works_get
tools.description: Get a single work by DOI. Required: doi. Optional: mailto. Returns the WorksGetResponse.

params.name: mailto
params.description: Contact email for the Crossref polite pool

tools.name: works_search
tools.description: Search or filter scholarly works. Optional: query, filter, sort (plus 5 more). Returns the WorksSearchResponse.

params.name: query
params.description: Free-text query across title, author, and metadata

params.name: filter
params.description: Crossref filter expression. Use update-type:retraction to list retraction notices, from-update-date:2024-01-01 to bound by update date, or type:journal-article to scope by work type.

params.name: select
params.description: Comma-separated fields to return (reduces payload size)

params.name: mailto
params.description: Contact email for the Crossref polite pool (better rate limits)
